Job description 
 Do you enjoy being active and ensuring that everything ends up in the right place? Then this position as Logistics Employee at KITT Engineering might be for you. As the link between storage in our warehouse in Eck en Wiel and the field service team, you ensure that material flows run smoothly.

Who are you? - You live within 30 minutes of Eck en Wiel. - You are a go-getter who likes to take responsibility. - You maintain an overview, work accurately, and find it important that colleagues can count on you. 
In addition, you recognize yourself in the following: - You have experience in a logistics or production environment. - You are in possession of a valid forklift/reach truck certificate (or are willing to obtain one). - You work accurately and in a structured manner. - You are physically fit and enjoy varied work. - You speak and understand the Dutch language well; a spoken English level is a plus. - You are collegial, reliable, and solution-oriented.
